name: DOCVAT-build v1 (sidecar)
description: Build + deploy Documentos Vaticanos. Coalesce + mutex global con IMPERIUM vía /tmp/codice-ci-global-build.json. flock local se mantiene. Webhook POST /webhook/docvat-build para reencolar (también desde IMPERIUM).

parameters.text: ={{ "🚀 Build Documentos Vaticanos iniciado\n📂 RafaelAngelRamirez/documentos-vaticanos\n🌿 Rama: " + $('Branch ctx').last().json.branch_name }}

parameters.command:
set -euo pipefail
LOCK=/tmp/docvat-build.lock
LOCK_WAIT_SEC="${DOCVAT_LOCK_WAIT_SEC:-7200}"
exec 9>"$LOCK"
echo "==> waiting up to ${LOCK_WAIT_SEC}s for $LOCK (pid $$)"
# BusyBox flock (n8n Alpine) has no -w (util-linux only); poll with flock -n
_deadline=$(( $(date +%s) + LOCK_WAIT_SEC ))
while ! flock -n 9; do
  if [ "$(date +%s)" -ge "$_deadline" ]; then
    echo "ERROR: timed out after ${LOCK_WAIT_SEC}s waiting for $LOCK" >&2
    exit 75
  fi
  sleep 5
done
echo "==> lock acquired $$ $(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)"
echo "$$ $(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)" > /tmp/docvat-build.owner
# Nuclear clean of the shared n8n_build volume mounted at /tmp/repo
# (cannot rmdir the mountpoint; wipe all contents including .git)
if [[ -d /tmp/repo ]]; then
  # Prefer find (handles deep trees); fall back to rm
  find /tmp/repo -mindepth 1 -maxdepth 1 -exec rm -rf {} + 2>/dev/null || true
  rm -rf /tmp/repo/.[!.]* /tmp/repo/..?* 2>/dev/null || true
fi
mkdir -p /tmp/repo
# Prove pack path is writable
mkdir -p /tmp/repo/.git-write-test && rmdir /tmp/repo/.git-write-test
echo "clean ok; free: $(df -h /tmp/repo | tail -1)"

set -euo pipefail
LOCK=/tmp/docvat-build.lock
LOCK_WAIT_SEC="${DOCVAT_LOCK_WAIT_SEC:-7200}"
exec 9>"$LOCK"
echo "==> waiting up to ${LOCK_WAIT_SEC}s for $LOCK (pid $$)"
# BusyBox flock (n8n Alpine) has no -w (util-linux only); poll with flock -n
_deadline=$(( $(date +%s) + LOCK_WAIT_SEC ))
while ! flock -n 9; do
  if [ "$(date +%s)" -ge "$_deadline" ]; then
    echo "ERROR: timed out after ${LOCK_WAIT_SEC}s waiting for $LOCK" >&2
    exit 75
  fi
  sleep 5
done
echo "==> lock acquired $$ $(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)"
echo "$$ $(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)" > /tmp/docvat-build.owner

BRANCH="${DOCVAT_BRANCH:-typescript-migration}"
if [[ -f /tmp/docvat-branch.txt ]]; then
  BRANCH=$(cat /tmp/docvat-branch.txt)
fi
# Isolate from Imperium files that share codice-progressio_n8n_build
# n8n sees volume at /tmp/repo; runner mounts same volume at /work
WORKDIR=/tmp/repo/docvat
echo "==> WORKDIR=$WORKDIR branch=$BRANCH"
rm -rf "$WORKDIR"
mkdir -p "$WORKDIR"
cd "$WORKDIR"

echo "==> clone (shallow + tags + deepen for standard-version)"
git clone --depth 1 --branch "$BRANCH" --single-branch \
  https://github.com/RafaelAngelRamirez/documentos-vaticanos.git .
# History + tags so standard-version can see commits since last release tag
git fetch --tags --force origin || true
git fetch --deepen=300 origin "$BRANCH" || true
CUR_VER=$(node -p "require('./package.json').version" 2>/dev/null || echo "")
if [[ -n "$CUR_VER" ]]; then
  git fetch origin "refs/tags/v${CUR_VER}:refs/tags/v${CUR_VER}" 2>/dev/null || true
fi
test -f package.json
test -f .ci-build.sh
test -f scripts/package-apk.sh
test -f frontend/android/app/capacitor.build.gradle
chmod +x .ci-build.sh
echo "==> checkout $(git rev-parse --short HEAD) $(git log -1 --oneline)"
echo "==> describe $(git describe --tags --always 2>/dev/null || echo n/a) package=$(node -p "require('./package.json').version")"

# Ensure CI runner image exists. It is pinned by host container
# imperium-build-runner-pin and mirrored as legna37/imperium-build-runner:latest.
# (update.sh used to `docker system prune --all` and wipe this image.)
ensure_runner_image() {
  if docker image inspect imperium-build-runner:latest >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    echo "==> runner image present: imperium-build-runner:latest"
    return 0
  fi
  echo "==> imperium-build-runner:latest missing — restoring from Docker Hub"
  if [[ -n "${DOCKER_USERNAME:-}" && -n "${DOCKER_TOKEN:-}" ]]; then
    echo "$DOCKER_TOKEN" | docker login -u "$DOCKER_USERNAME" --password-stdin >/dev/null
  fi
  docker pull legna37/imperium-build-runner:latest
  docker tag legna37/imperium-build-runner:latest imperium-build-runner:latest
  # re-pin so the next prune --all cannot delete it again
  docker start imperium-build-runner-pin 2>/dev/null || \
    docker run -d --name imperium-build-runner-pin --restart unless-stopped \
      --label com.codice.keep-image=imperium-build-runner \
      imperium-build-runner:latest sleep infinity 2>/dev/null || true
  if ! docker image inspect imperium-build-runner:latest >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    echo "ERROR: imperium-build-runner:latest still missing after pull" >&2
    exit 3
  fi
}
ensure_runner_image

SOCK_GID=$(stat -c %g /var/run/docker.sock)
echo "==> docker run sidecar (volume at /work, repo at /work/docvat)"
# Use repo .ci-build.sh (release first, then packages + deploy).
# Version bump is ON by default. Emergency: DV_SKIP_RELEASE=1 on the host/n8n env.
docker run --rm --network codice-progressio_default --user 1000:1000 --group-add "$SOCK_GID" \
  -v /var/run/docker.sock:/var/run/docker.sock \
  -v codice-progressio_n8n_build:/work \
  -v codice-progressio_n8n_android_sdk:/work/docvat/frontend/.android-build-tools \
  -v codice-progressio_n8n_gradle:/cache/gradle \
  -v codice-progressio_n8n_electron:/cache/electron \
  ${DOCVAT_SECRETS_MOUNT:+-v $DOCVAT_SECRETS_MOUNT} \
  -e HOME=/cache/gradle/.home_runner \
  -e GRADLE_USER_HOME=/cache/gradle \
  -e ELECTRON_BUILDER_CACHE=/cache/electron \
  -e DOCKER_USERNAME="$DOCKER_USERNAME" \
  -e DOCKER_TOKEN="$DOCKER_TOKEN" \
  -e JAVA_HOME=/usr/lib/jvm/temurin-21-jdk-amd64 \
  -e DV_CI_ROOT=/work/docvat \
  -e DV_SKIP_RELEASE="${DV_SKIP_RELEASE:-0}" \
  -e DV_REQUIRE_WIN=1 \
  -e DV_REQUIRE_ALL_DOWNLOADS=1 \
  -e DV_BUILD_AAB="${DV_BUILD_AAB:-0}" \
  -e DV_PLAY_UPLOAD="${DV_PLAY_UPLOAD:-0}" \
  -e DV_PACKAGE_NAME="${DV_PACKAGE_NAME:-com.docvat}" \
  -e DV_KEYSTORE_PATH="${DV_KEYSTORE_PATH:-}" \
  -e DV_KEYSTORE_PASSWORD="${DV_KEYSTORE_PASSWORD:-}" \
  -e DV_KEY_ALIAS="${DV_KEY_ALIAS:-docvat-upload}" \
  -e DV_KEY_PASSWORD="${DV_KEY_PASSWORD:-}" \
  -e PLAY_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_JSON="${PLAY_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_JSON:-}" \
  -e PLAY_PACKAGE_NAME="${PLAY_PACKAGE_NAME:-com.docvat}" \
  -e PLAY_TRACK="${PLAY_TRACK:-closed}" \
  -e PLAY_STATUS="${PLAY_STATUS:-completed}" \
  -e BUILD_NOTIFY_WEBHOOK=http://n8n:5678/webhook/build-progress \
  -w /work/docvat \
  imperium-build-runner:latest bash /work/docvat/.ci-build.sh
rc=$?
echo "==> build exit $rc"
exit $rc

set -euo pipefail
# Repo lives under isolated WORKDIR (not volume root /tmp/repo).
WORKDIR=/tmp/repo/docvat
cd "$WORKDIR" || { echo "ERROR: missing $WORKDIR — build sidecar clone failed?" >&2; exit 1; }

git config user.name "Mr. Nochon"
git config user.email "mr.nochon@codice-progressio.online"

VERSION="$(node -p "require('./package.json').version" 2>/dev/null || echo "")"
if [[ -z "$VERSION" ]]; then
  echo "ERROR: cannot read package.json version in $WORKDIR" >&2
  exit 1
fi
echo "==> post-build release check: v${VERSION}"
git log -1 --oneline
git status -sb || true

# standard-version (inside sidecar) should already have committed + tagged.
# If bump files exist uncommitted (e.g. interrupted commit), finish the release here.
git add \
  package.json \
  frontend/package.json \
  scripts-descarga/package.json \
  CHANGELOG.md \
  frontend/CHANGELOG.md \
  scripts-descarga/CHANGELOG.md \
  frontend/src/environments/environment.ts \
  frontend/src/environments/environment.prod.ts \
  easy_version \
  README.md \
  2>/dev/null || true

if git diff --cached --quiet; then
  echo "artifact: working tree release files already committed (or unchanged)"
else
  git commit -m "chore(release): ${VERSION} [skip ci]"
  echo "artifact: committed remaining version files for v${VERSION}"
fi

if git rev-parse "v${VERSION}" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  echo "artifact: tag v${VERSION} present"
else
  git tag -a "v${VERSION}" -m "chore(release): ${VERSION}"
  echo "artifact: created tag v${VERSION}"
fi

echo "::DOCVAT_RELEASE_READY::v${VERSION}"

parameters.text:
={{ "✅ Documentos Vaticanos listo
Versión: " + $("Extraer versión").item.json.app_version + "
🌐 https://docvat.codice-progressio.online/
📦 /downloads APK + Electron Linux/Windows" }}

parameters.errorMessage: ={{ (() => { const j=$json||{}; const raw=String(j.error||j.stderr||j.message||j.stdout||'Build sidecar failed'); return raw.length>500?raw.slice(-500):raw; })() }}

parameters.command: ={{ 'CI_OWNER=docvat CI_OTHER=imperium CI_DEFAULT_BRANCH=typescript-migration CI_BRANCH=' + JSON.stringify($json.branch_name || 'typescript-migration') + ' sh -c "echo  | base64 -d > /tmp/codice-ci-acquire-docvat.js && node /tmp/codice-ci-acquire-docvat.js"' }}

parameters.text: ={{ "⏳ " + $json.message + "\n(Los commits se acumulan; un solo rebuild al terminar el build actual)" }}

parameters.command: ={{ 'CI_OWNER=docvat CI_OTHER=imperium CI_DEFAULT_BRANCH=typescript-migration CI_OTHER_DEFAULT=stable CI_FAILED=' + JSON.stringify($json.ci_failed ? '1' : '0') + ' sh -c "echo  | base64 -d > /tmp/codice-ci-release-docvat.js && node /tmp/codice-ci-release-docvat.js"' }}
